input.command:
npm run typecheck >/tmp/tc.log 2>&1; echo "typecheck exit=$?"; (PORT=3917 node .output/server/index.mjs >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
B=http://localhost:3917
echo "--- quote"; curl -s -XPOST $B/api/cart/quote -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"notebook","qty":2},{"slug":"pencil","qty":3}],"code":"save10"}'; echo
echo "--- create"; R=$(curl -s -XPOST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"notebook","qty":2},{"slug":"pencil","qty":3}],"code":"save10"}'); echo $R
ID=$(echo $R | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0)).id')
echo "--- get"; curl -s $B/api/orders/$ID; echo
echo "--- get missing"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' $B/api/orders/nope
echo "--- bad slug"; curl -s -XPOST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"nope","qty":1}]}'; echo
echo "--- empty"; curl -s -XPOST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[]}'; echo
echo "--- bad qty"; curl -s -XPOST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"pencil","qty":0}]}'; echo
echo "--- page"; curl -s $B/orders/$ID | grep -oE '<li class="order-line"[^<]*<[^>]*>[^<]*|id="order-total"[^<]*|\$[0-9.]+' | head; echo
echo "--- page missing"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' $B/orders/nope
pkill -f "PORT=3917" ; pkill -f ".output/server/index.mjs"; true
